findings: Not one of 1008 files was classified mechanical. Either the codebase genuinely has none, or thresholds.mechanical is miscalibrated against this model. Calibration is what settles which; do not retune the Threshold to taste.

Sustained 2960.8 requests/minute against a documented limit of 1200, with no rejections. The documented limit was not enforced here, so the throughput model should not treat it as a hard ceiling -- nor assume exceeding it is safe.
